posts.title: Introducing replacemrr: Who Replaced Whose MRR
posts.description: Everyone is talking about SaaS getting killed. Is this really happening? replacemrr.com is a tracker of the SaaS bills that are replaced: old bill, new running cost, net saved. Submit yours!

posts.title: AI Promised Less Work. I Have Never Worked More.
posts.description: Agents made implementation cheap, so I started doing far more of it in parallel. My GitHub history since 2019 shows what that did: as VP of Technology I am back at my full-stack engineer pace, with bursts, burnout and a low season that is no longer low.

posts.title: I Don't Write Code Anymore. I Still Read It.
posts.description: Agents write all my code now. I still keep asking them to simplify it, because unnecessary complexity creates more to reason about and more places for bugs.
